items.title: Joe Temperley interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: Phil Woods had a funny remark.

ctx.x: Every day. Ten hours, twelve hours a day. And then playing a gig at the end of it. Phil Woods had a funny remark. He said “When these kids graduate from school, they should be taken and they should all be put in a bus and they should pull the blinds down, and the bus should just ride around the campus for about ten hours. And then they should all get © Hamilton College Jazz Archive -6-

out and go into the gym and play a four hour gig, and then get back in the bus and ride for another ten hours, and then see if they want to really be musicians.” That was before they get presented with their diploma.
